nodes.description: Ownable owner address state variable holding the contract administrator.
Ownable constructor that sets the initial owner from msg.sender.
Ownable.transferOwnership, onlyOwner, changes owner to newOwner.
External caller address used for ownership and authorization.

Constant total supply of the Token contract.
Timestamp from which transfer taxation becomes active.
Public counter of current token holders in the sorted linked list.
Constant GUARD sentinel address used as head/tail of the holder list.
Private mapping of holder balances.
Private nested mapping of owner-spender allowances.
Private mapping forming the sorted linked list of holders.
Token constructor initializing holder list, tax start and minting supply.
onlyOwner function that moves the tax start timestamp into the future.
External approve function writing spender allowances.
View function returning allowance of a spender for an owner.
View function returning the balance of an address.
Public transfer that checks sender balance then calls _transferFrom.
Public transferFrom that checks balance and allowance then calls _transferFrom.
Private core transfer routine handling tax, holder list and balance updates.
Private function inserting a new holder into the sorted linked list.
Private function removing a holder from the sorted linked list.
Returns the first k holders by traversing the linked list in a loop.
Returns the n-th holder by traversing the linked list in a loop.
Internal function that updates a balance in place or re-inserts the holder.
Internal view checking whether a value fits between two list positions.
Internal function scanning the list with an unbounded while(true) loop.
Internal view checking if prev is the predecessor of who in the list.
Internal function searching for the predecessor of a holder.
Private function deriving a pseudo-random holder from block data.
Internal recursive quicksort used for ordering arrays.
Block timestamp (now) used for tax timing and randomness seed.
_beginTax = now + 60 minutes in the constructor (timestamp dependency).
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(now, block.difficulty, msg.sender)) weak randomness.
tax = value.mul(15).div(100) arithmetic on user-supplied value.
_allowances[from][msg.sender].sub(value) SafeMath subtraction on allowance.
require(msg.sender == owner) access control gate in the onlyOwner modifier.
owner = newOwner privileged state write in transferOwnership.
Unbounded while(true) traversal loop in _findIndex (DoS risk).
Loops over holders in getTopHolders/getTopHolder bounded by holdersCount.
_beginTax = start state write in setTax after future-timestamp check.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter exists only to feed the owner state write in transferOwnership.
The start parameter exists only to be stored into _beginTax by setTax.
The spender parameter is only used as the mapping key inside approve.
The amount parameter is only used to set the allowance inside approve.
The transfer destination is forwarded to _transferFrom for the actual movement.
The transfer amount is forwarded to _transferFrom for the actual movement.
The from parameter is only used for balance and allowance checks inside transferFrom.
The to parameter is only forwarded by transferFrom.
The value parameter drives the allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
The who parameter identifies the holder inserted by addHolder.
The destination parameter is consumed by the balance update logic of _transferFrom.
The value parameter is reduced by the tax arithmetic before balances are updated.
The k parameter only bounds the traversal loop in getTopHolders.
The n parameter only bounds the traversal loop in getTopHolder.
The local tax variable is the result of the mul/div tax computation.
The local random address is derived from the pseudo-random holder selection.
The local randomIndex is consumed by getTopHolder to pick the taxed holder.
